header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: If You take my soul while I sleep, have mercy on it! If You keep it alive, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants!” — let him recite this Du'a” — Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ﵂ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْقُدَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْني تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: اَللّهُمَّ! قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب مايقول عند النوم رقم:٥٠٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the Prophet ﷺ intended to sleep, he would place his right hand under his right cheek and say three times the Du'a (اَللّهُمَّ! قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ) O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the day You raise Your servants from the graves!” — narrates Hazrat Hafsah (RA), the beloved wife of the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَمَا لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ يَقُولُ حِينَ يَاْتِي أَهْلَهُ: بِسْمِ اللهِ اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَارَزَقْتَنَا ثُمَّ قُدِّرَ بَيْنَهُمَا فِي ذلِكَ أَوْ قُضِيَ وَلَدٌ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْطَانٌ أَبَدًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب مايقول اذا اتي اهله رقم:٥١٦٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “When anyone goes to his wife, let him recite the Du'a (بِسْمِ )اللهِ اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَارَزَقْتَنَا”In the name of Allah Ta'ala I do this act. O Allah, protect me from Shaytan! And protect from Shaytan the offspring You give us! Then if a child is born to him from that marital relation, Shaytan will never be able to harm that child. Shaytan will not succeed in leading that child astray” — Hazrat Ibn
